schema.source_verified: verifier-confirmed (an independent verifier re-ran it at the primary source) | source-read (read at the source itself, at the version named in detectors) | scraper-fetched
schema.detectable: true when a mechanical check is proposed
schema.proposed_check: id, where it runs (audit: scripts/tells.mjs on source; tells: scripts/tells-render.mjs on the rendered page), and the rule
schema.ufs_chassis_ships_it: true when UFS assets currently produce this pattern
schema.first_seen: the earliest date UFS has evidence the source names it (YYYY-MM when the source dates it only by month)
schema.last_confirmed: the last date the source was re-read and still names it
schema.detectors: the detector rules and skill sections that name it, with versions

entries.tell: Identical fade-up on every section with uniform stagger
entries.why: Framer Motion default repeated; no hierarchy
entries.instead: Reveal only what carries the argument; vary the verb; leave sections still

proposed_check.rule: warn when one reveal keyframe/duration pair is applied inside more than 60% of section elements

entries.tell: 0.1 s stagger everywhere; 4 px card hover lift
entries.instead: Stagger ordered lists only; hover changes state

proposed_check.rule: warn on :hover translateY(-4px) or -translate-y-1 on card-like selectors

entries.tell: Scroll progress bar on a short marketing page

proposed_check.rule: warn when .progress or a scroll() timeline bar exists and body text is under about 1,500 words

entries.tell: Count-up stat banners

proposed_check.rule: warn when data-count is used and no cite element, footnote or source link sits in the same section

entries.tell: Bounce/elastic easing on dialogs and cards

proposed_check.rule: warn on cubic-bezier with y1 or y2 above 1, or back/elastic/bounce eases, on dialog/modal/card selectors

entries.tell: ease-in entrances; scale(0) starts

proposed_check.rule: warn on scale(0) in from/0% keyframes and ease-in on keyframes named in/enter/show/reveal

entries.tell: Motion incoherence

proposed_check.rule: warn when more than 6 distinct durations or more than 4 distinct timing functions appear

entries.tell: Cursor-following glow / drifting blobs
entries.instead: One colour field with a reason

proposed_check.rule: warn when a mousemove/pointermove handler writes a CSS variable used in a radial-gradient position

entries.tell: Infinite loop or marquee with no pause

proposed_check.rule: warn on an infinite animation with no button[aria-pressed] or [data-pause] in the page

entries.tell: Unmodified shadcn/Tailwind components

proposed_check.rule: warn when the shadcn default variable block (--radius: 0.5rem with --background/--card/--popover/--muted) is present unmodified

entries.tell: Lucide Sparkles/Zap/Shield/BarChart3/Check feature icons

proposed_check.rule: warn when three or more of these lucide names appear

entries.tell: Most Popular tier, Built with care footer, traffic-light terminal mockup

proposed_check.rule: warn on the strings "Most Popular" and "Built with care", and on three adjacent round red/yellow/green dots

entries.tell: blue-600 to purple-500/pink-500 gradient; emerald-500 success

proposed_check.rule: extend SLOP_HEX with #10b981 and flag gradients pairing #2563eb with #a855f7 or #ec4899 in any notation

entries.tell: Section waterfall order

proposed_check.rule: warn when section ids/classes follow hero, logos, features, stats, testimonials, pricing, faq, cta in that order

entries.tell: Em-dash density and tricolons

proposed_check.rule: warn above 20 em dashes per 1,000 words of visible text (threshold already stated in tells.md)

entries.tell: A warm cream or beige ground
entries.why: The "tasteful" AI surface: the escape route from white became the default
entries.instead: A ground taken from the subject, or white or a cool neutral; cream only when the subject is paper

proposed_check.rule: the largest-area ground among html, body, main and the first section is OKLCH L >= 0.90, C 0.005-0.04, H 60-100

entries.tell: Near-black ground with no light scheme
entries.why: Dark as a look rather than a choice the reader can undo
entries.instead: A light scheme, or dark because the subject is night, with a prefers-color-scheme: light answer

proposed_check.rule: ground OKLCH L <= 0.25 and no prefers-color-scheme: light rule

entries.tell: Cream ground, high-contrast serif, terracotta or clay accent
entries.why: The first cluster AI design converges on; the accent near #D97757 is Anthropic's own
entries.instead: Break at least two legs of it: the ground, the serif, the accent

proposed_check.rule: cream-ground, a serif h1, and a rendered colour at C >= 0.08 with H 20-60

entries.tell: Near-black with one acid-green or vermilion accent
entries.why: The second cluster: one loud accent on black reads as a template
entries.instead: A palette with more than one idea, or a ground chosen by the subject

proposed_check.rule: perma-dark and every colour at C >= 0.15 in one hue group

entries.tell: Tracked all-caps eyebrows, mono data labels, "·"-joined meta, "→" on links
entries.why: Chrome that appears whatever the subject
entries.instead: Labels only where they carry information, in sentence case; plain link text

proposed_check.rule: count text <= 14px in uppercase at >= 0.08em tracking, short mono labels, " · " meta strings and links ending in "→"; fire at 4

entries.tell: Instrument Sans, Plus Jakarta Sans, Mona Sans, Open Sans, Geist Mono and the rest of SLOP_FONTS
entries.why: Each wave of generated UI converges on the same faces; this is the Anthropic-skill and Vercel wave
entries.instead: A face chosen for the subject (typography.md)

proposed_check.rule: the first family the h1, body or button asks for is on SLOP_FONTS

entries.tell: One headline word set apart in italic, colour or weight
entries.why: The most imitated headline device of 2026
entries.instead: Let the whole headline carry it; one such device per page at most

proposed_check.rule: an h1 descendant differs in colour, style, face, weight or gradient from the rest of the h1

detectors: frontend-design SKILL.md (accenting a single headline word)

entries.tell: 01 / 02 / 03 on headings that are not a sequence
entries.why: Editorial scaffolding: a page numbering its own chapters

proposed_check.rule: three sibling headings, or siblings holding one, prefixed 01, 02, 03 in text, ::before or the list marker

entries.tell: A row of big numerals with small labels
entries.why: The default hero and proof treatment
entries.instead: Numbers inside sentences, with a source and a date

proposed_check.rule: three or more siblings whose largest text is a number at >= 2x the body size

entries.tell: Identical rounded cards with the same soft shadow
entries.why: The SaaS card kit: one radius on everything regardless of hierarchy
entries.instead: Radius and elevation by hierarchy, or none

proposed_check.rule: six or more boxes of 120x80 px or more sharing one border-radius and one box-shadow

entries.tell: An auto-scrolling marquee
entries.why: Motion that demands attention it has not earned and hides half its content
entries.instead: Static text, or motion that answers the reader

proposed_check.rule: a stylesheet rule or running animation that loops forever and translates on x, or a <marquee>

entries.tell: Everything centred on the page axis
entries.why: A centred stack is the layout a generator reaches for first
entries.instead: Left-aligned text on a grid; centre one element, not the page

proposed_check.rule: the share of text blocks whose every line is centred within 2% of the axis; fire at half, over 5 blocks

entries.tell: The scaffold's default section order, left as it came
entries.why: UFS's own waterfall: nav, hero-photo, manifesto, services, stats, faq, contact, footer
entries.instead: Sections chosen and ordered for the brief (new --sections)

proposed_check.rule: the rendered top-level blocks, matched to library sections, run in exactly DEFAULT_SECTIONS

entries.tell: Crushed display tracking
entries.why: Collided letters on display type read as a template setting
entries.instead: -0.01 to -0.035em on display sizes; never -0.05em or tighter

proposed_check.rule: records the tightest tracking on display text (28px and up); fires at -0.05em or tighter

entries.tell: Script longer than runtime

proposed_check.rule: warn when words in scene text or a VO script exceed 2.7 per second of video.json seconds

entries.tell: Corporate Memphis figures
Generated footage in a warmth-based brand film
Generator physics or continuity errors in any clip
entries.why: Named limits of the video models

entries.tell: Mass-produced template videos

proposed_check.rule: warn when a batch of renders differs only in text nodes

entries.tell: Captions breaking reading rules

proposed_check.rule: error over 42 chars per line or 2 lines; warn over 20 CPS or outside 5/6 s to 7 s

entries.tell: Loudness jumps and clipped peaks

proposed_check.rule: measure with ffmpeg ebur128; warn outside target +/-1 LU or TP above -1 dBTP

entries.tell: One preset grade on every clip
entries.why: A look applied instead of shots balanced; the teal-and-orange trend dates from 2010
entries.instead: Balance each shot, then apply one look

entries.tell: Juice on everything

proposed_check.rule: report shake/flash triggers per second over a recorded session (report only)

entries.tell: Generated assets shipped without saying so
entries.why: Steam requires disclosure of AI-generated content (clarified January 2026)

entries.tell: Unreviewed generated code
WASD bound to event.key

proposed_check.rule: warn when a script compares event.key to w/a/s/d letters

entries.tell: AudioContext outside a gesture, never resumed
entries.instead: Create/resume in the first input handler

proposed_check.rule: warn when new AudioContext appears at top level and no .resume() call exists

entries.tell: Simulation runs in hidden tab

proposed_check.rule: warn when a requestAnimationFrame game loop exists and no visibilitychange listener

entries.tell: A logo that fills every inch, template symmetry, no one-colour or small version
entries.instead: A construction grid, and positive, negative, one-colour and minimum-size versions
entries.source_verified: snippet only (not re-read on the page)

entries.tell: Raster inside a vector mark

proposed_check.rule: warn on an image element inside an SVG used as a logo or icon

entries.tell: Mixed icon sets and stroke widths
entries.instead: One set, one grid, one stroke

proposed_check.rule: warn when more than one icon library is referenced, or inline SVG icons carry more than one stroke-width value

entries.tell: Corporate Memphis illustration
entries.instead: One drawn voice, from the subject

entries.tell: Generated lettering anywhere
entries.why: Stroke weights that disagree across the alphabet
